summary: AI OKTO Corp., a Cyprus-domiciled Nasdaq Capital Market foreign private issuer (ticker AIOK), filed a 6-K attaching the shareholder notice and election form for a previously declared special dividend of $3.50 per common share, payable November 25, 2026 to holders of record November 2, 2026. Shareholders may elect all-cash or all-stock; stock is valued at $4.5159 (5-day VWAP through October 22, 2026), cash in lieu of fractions, elections due November 19. Nasdaq advised shares trade with due bills because the dividend exceeds 25% of the trading price; the company may unilaterally pay all cash through November 24. Watch for stock-election uptake driving dilution and post-due-bill price adjustment.
